headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: LAW (4)

summary: Lewis Hamilton won the Chinese Grand Prix Sprint from pole position, 6.9s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with Max Verstappen completing the podium.
Pierre Gasly made the biggest climb, from P17 to P12.
Jack Doohan had a day to forget, dropping from P16 to P20.
There were 1 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 0 times.
Lando Norris leads the championship by 2 points over Max Verstappen.
